raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with a three-layered architecture. Layer 1 (Observe) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns including application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2 (Intelligence Layer) acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, the business value of tasks, and "drift" where work diverges from the intended flow. Layer 3 (Execution Layer) is an "Agent Factory" that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. It leverages existing foundation models, focusing on the "Work Graph" to identify where resources are inefficiencies and where AI can provide mid-flow assistance to deliver a "Continuous AI lift." The system aims to provide a single solution that observes work, decides what AI should do, and continuously self-builds agents.
raw.one_liner: Narma is an Enterprise Agentic Brain for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's core innovation is its integrated, three-layered approach that moves beyond traditional AI monitoring to proactive, intelligent automation. Instead of merely tracking AI performance, it observes work patterns, detects employee intent and workflow drift, and then autonomously generates and deploys AI agents to address high-ROI opportunities. This "Work Graph" approach, coupled with continuous agent generation, is genuinely new.

raw.thesis: Narma is building an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" to help AI-first companies identify, validate, and deploy AI automation at scale. The venture aims to solve the critical challenges enterprises face with AI adoption: lack of clear telemetry for AI savings, unreliable ROI measurements, and continuous divergence in operational workflows. Narma seeks to provide a comprehensive solution that observes work patterns, understands employee intent and business value of tasks, and then autonomously generates and deploys AI agents to capture high-ROI automation opportunities. This ensures a "Continuous AI lift" by proactively detecting where AI can intervene effectively. The innovation lies in its three-layered architecture focusing on observation, intelligent intent detection, and automated agent generation, leveraging existing foundation models and prioritizing the "Work Graph" to pinpoint inefficiencies. The founder's goal is to build a growth startup that fundamentally changes how AI-first companies implement and scale AI automation, moving beyond theoretical benefits to demonstrable, continuous impact. The venture is currently at the idea stage, with the founder articulating a clear vision and product architecture but lacking tangible evidence of building or user engagement. Narma is positioned to complement existing AI solutions by providing the critical missing layer of intelligence and automation orchestration that helps enterprises maximize the value of their AI investments, rather than replacing core AI models or enterprise software.
